leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the useMemo hook to memoize computed values and prevent unnecessary recalculations.
Implement the useCallback hook to memoize callback functions and maintain stable references.
Utilize the React.memo higher-order component to prevent unnecessary re-renders of functional components.
Construct memoized components that only re-render when their props have changed.
Define custom comparison functions for React.memo to control when memoization should update.
Execute dependency arrays in useMemo and useCallback to specify when memoized values should be recalculated.
Assign memoized callback functions to event handlers to prevent child component re-renders.
Access and compare previous and current prop values within memoized components.
Control component re-renders by strategically applying memoization techniques.
Return memoized JSX structures from components to optimize rendering performance.
Modify existing components to incorporate memoization strategies for performance improvements.
